The wheel features a dark brown or bronze-colored rim with an intricate, lattice-like spoke design that appears somewhat organic or melted rather than mechanical. A black rubber tire is mounted on the rim. There is a rectangular white label with gibberish text attached to the tire sidewall. The lighting creates strong highlights on the rim's upper edge.
